title: Ring-motility tradeoff replicates on seed 3: static ring 2.25, swimmers 1.52; a stronger ring (a=3) gives 1.82 with 0 swim-divide events
summary: Fresh seed 3 with the author's swimtrack.py to t=8000. Static cells (mu=0, chi=2): wall/core link 2.25 over all cells (claim 2.21/2.25), 18 dividers, 0 swimmers. Swimming at chi=2, mu=2.2: swimmers >= 3 BL hold 1.52 (all cells 1.64), 20 swimmers, 21 dividers, 1 swim-divide event (its ring 1.71). Stronger ring via tilt a=3 (chi=2): ring 1.82 for swimmers, but only 8 swimmers, 3 dividers and 0 swim-divide events. The labkit pack of the default (chi=1.5, mu=2.2) shows comet swimmers with a bright front cap and a link wake (rerun/sheet.png), as the finding describes.

observations.F: st_mu0c2.log ring_all 2.25 vs st_c2m22.log ring_swimmers 1.52; st_c2a3m22.log ring 1.82 with swim_divide 0; rerun/sheet.png front caps and wakes

seeds_run.result: pass (swimmer ring 1.52, at the top of the claimed 0.95-1.50 range)

controls_run.F: st_mu0c2/ (static arm, same chi and seed)

verdicts.limitation: Three of the 24 configurations re-run on one new seed. Swim-divide events are rare on this seed (0-1), so the tradeoff curve's division side rests on small counts.
